title: Manchester People’s Panel shapes a proposed public-facing Caddy AI advice service
summary: Manchester residents proposed safeguards for a public-facing Caddy service. Wider access to understandable advice remains intended; the panel’s design recommendations are reported.
account: In a September 2026 post, Citizens Advice SORT’s Stuart Pearson describes a January panel that considered three proposals for public-facing Caddy and proposed a fourth. Residents called for client choice, human escalation for red flags, and transparency. They also noted that members of the public would lack trained advisers’ prompting skills. A separate Open University interview describes an earlier presentation in July 2024. The council’s LGA account reports learning and confidence changes from its wider participation program, not improved outcomes from Caddy. None of these accounts establishes deployment of the proposed public service or a benefit to its clients.
purpose: Extend access to understandable advice through a proposed public-facing AI service with human escalation and user choice.
system: Proposed public-facing Caddy AI advice service
developer: Citizens Advice Stockport, Oldham, Rochdale and Trafford
deployer: Citizens Advice Stockport, Oldham, Rochdale and Trafford (proposed public-facing service)
